title: centaurium pulchellum f. albiflorum
intro: Centaurium pulchellum f. albiflorum, commonly known as White-centred Centaury, is a flowering plant in the gentian family (Gentianaceae). This plant is prized for its medicinal properties and has been used in traditional herbal medicine to treat a range of health issues. The health benefits of Centaurium pulchellum f. albiflorum include its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can help to soothe digestive issues and reduce inflammation in the body. The bioactive constituents of this plant include iridoid glycosides, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions of reducing fever, promoting digestion, and exhibiting antioxidant properties.
